basis: Natural Earth 1:50m land polygons clipped to the Indian Ocean theatre
method: A* over a 0.1 degree water raster with an offshore-distance penalty, Douglas-Peucker at 3.5 km, then land-checked Chaikin smoothing
disclaimer: VISUALISATION ONLY. These polylines are not a navigational product. They carry no depth, traffic separation or notice-to-mariners information and must not be used for passage planning.
